title: Public safety-source status as of September 11, 2026
summary: Most public safety databases available in the app showed no major platform change that should affect data freshness or availability. One routine check of Brazil’s public safety-alert search was blocked on September 11, 2026; this is being verified and may temporarily delay updates from that source.
updates: Brazil (ANVISA): The public safety-alert search could not be reached in the September 11, 2026 routine check. We are verifying whether this is temporary; recent alert updates may be delayed until access is confirmed.
Switzerland (Swissmedic): A registration transition continues through December 31, 2026, with no observed change to the public safety-notice listings.
no_major_changes: No meaningful setup or access change was identified for FDA MAUDE, FDA recalls and safety communications, BfArM, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, AEMPS, ANSM, PMDA, or the current English-language NMPA coverage.
